sources.name: TrialGPT
sources.pointers: Abstract; Methods: TrialGPT, Patient cohorts, TREC2021/2022; Results: first-stage retrieval and criterion-level prediction
sources.overlap: Retrieval plus criterion-level reasoning and ranking are already established contributions.
sources.remaining_distinction: A diagnosis-level sarcoma benchmark is narrower than patient-trial matching, but needs independent labels and evidence of a useful retrieval tradeoff.

sources.name: MatchMiner
sources.publication: npj Precision Oncology 2022, peer-reviewed primary study
sources.pointers: Results: MatchMiner capabilities; Clinical trial markup language; Discussion
sources.overlap: Genomic and clinical Boolean criteria, exclusions and arm-level matching predate this pilot.
sources.remaining_distinction: Public-registry discovery behavior is different from institutional curated matching; merely recommending criteria inspection is not new.

sources.name: RareCure
sources.pointers: Materials and Methods: Module4 Clinical trial matching with ontology expansion; Figure2; Table2; Discussion: Limitations
sources.overlap: Explicit rare-sarcoma subtype-to-parent-to-solid-tumor expansion overlaps the proposed discovery remedy. Its hierarchy covers 11 sarcoma subtypes with a fallback.
sources.remaining_distinction: The paper explicitly did not quantify marginal ontology-expansion contribution through module-level ablation. An independently labeled molecular-versus-hierarchy benchmark could fill that gap. This pilot does not establish such a benchmark, nor a molecular gain over parent sarcoma for its clearest supported examples.

sources.name: TrialGPT2.0
sources.overlap: Claims multicenter and prospective workflow evaluation; general overlooked-trial discovery is crowded.
sources.remaining_distinction: Abstract-level check only; its numerical clinical-workflow claims are not adopted or independently verified here.

decision: Existing methods do not prove the proposed benchmark useless. They do make a keyword expansion plus anecdotal omission paper insufficiently distinct. A useful new benchmark would need independent bounded diagnosis/cohort labels, solid-tumor hierarchy comparator, marginal yield/false-positive burden and phase-level availability assessment.
